back: A club's income statement on the accruals basis, ending in a surplus or a deficit.
Opening accumulated fund + surplus (or − deficit) for the year.
Cash paid − opening accrual + closing accrual (prepayments: + opening, − closing).
Equipment bought is a non-current asset; only depreciation goes in the income and expenditure account.

front: Receipts and payments vs income and expenditure
back: R&P: cash basis, capital items included, ends with the bank balance. I&E: accruals basis, depreciation, ends with surplus or deficit.

front: Steps from receipts and payments to final accounts
back: Opening fund → subscriptions account → activity trading accounts → adjust expenses → remove capital items, add depreciation → I&E → statement of financial position.

front: Why can cash rise while a club has a deficit?
back: Advances received, bills unpaid and depreciation (no cash) all separate cash from the surplus or deficit.

front: Subscriptions balances in the statement of financial position
back: Arrears: current asset. Advances: current liability.
